            local work = {}

-- An example of coding up graph coloring in the Luau type system.
-- This codes a three-node, two color problem.

  & ((Color) -> (Red) -> (Red) -> false)
  & ((Color) -> (Blue) -> (Blue) -> false)

  & ((Blue) -> (Color) -> (Blue) -> false)

local x : Triangle
